BCG Solutions in the Forest Product, Paper, and Packaging Industry
In addition to our proprietary sector knowledge, BCG brings ready-to-use market models, toolkits, and databases to its work with forest product, paper, and packaging clients. Project work spans key functional topics, including:Digital transformationOperations, including people and organizationCorporate development and strategySales planningSupply chainManufacturing and process improvements, including predictive maintenance and smart-factory systemsNew business opportunities, including new ventures, partnerships, and mergers and acquisitionsFor work that involves digital transformation for forest products, our industry experts work hand in hand with digital experts from BCG X, BCG’s tech build and design unit. BCG X brings together advanced tech knowledge and ambitious entrepreneurship to help organizations launch their next big bets and enable innovation at scale. Its global team of world-class technologists, scientists, programmers, engineers, and designers includes experts in advanced analytics, AI, digital solutions, launching or investing in a new business, and much more.The BCG forest products consulting team also collaborates with other experts in the firm on issues related to sustainability, forest building materials, operations, marketing, and sales and pricing.
